prompts.artists-v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Kalinka Artists music-library category card, wide 3:1 production artwork. Input image 1 is the edit target. Keep the vintage brass vocal microphone sharp in the foreground, its berry-red details, cinematic low-key studio lighting, textured charcoal palette, and broad dark empty LEFT HALF unchanged. Replace the blurry guitar behind the microphone with an anonymous singing human shadow silhouette: a head-and-shoulders profile behind and just to the RIGHT of the microphone, turned left toward it, mouth gently open in song. The singer should read as a dark shadow with a restrained warm ivory and muted berry-red rim light, with no distinct facial features or identifiable likeness. Keep the silhouette clearly visible at small card size without overpowering the microphone. All subject matter in the right half, generous breathing room at the right edge. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, or UI. Preserve panoramic 3:1 framing, opaque background, premium photographic texture.
